Container.Name: Rivune
Container.Overview:
Rivune is an open-source, self-hosted media frontend and backend. The application contains no predefined catalogue or media service: users connect their own addons and sources.
REQUIRED: A TLS-enabled PostgreSQL server must already exist. Create separate custom Docker networks named for example rivune-edge and rivune-database: connect Rivune to both, the HTTPS reverse proxy only to edge, and PostgreSQL only to database. Do not put the proxy and PostgreSQL on one network.
REQUIRED: Reach Rivune only through an HTTPS reverse proxy on the edge network. This template deliberately does not publish Rivune's raw HTTP port on the Unraid host. Set Public URL to the proxy's HTTPS origin and configure Trusted reverse proxies for the edge network; do not add a host port mapping for 8080.
AMD/Intel GPU: this template maps /dev/dri/renderD128 and adds Unraid's usual video group GID 18. Verify the actual GID with: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128. If it differs, replace --group-add=18 under Advanced View / Extra Parameters.
Database credentials, the initial setup token, and optional provider credentials are configured directly as masked environment variables in this template. Choose long, independent random values. PostgreSQL must present a certificate signed by the mounted CA whose SAN exactly matches PostgreSQL host; Rivune uses sslmode=verify-full and never falls back to plaintext. The configured application role must be non-superuser; use separate bootstrap and restore roles on PostgreSQL as documented in docs/operations.md. Rivune prepares the transcode directory as root, then permanently drops to the configured non-root PUID and PGID.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 14 or newer with TLS enabled, a CA certificate mounted read-only, separate edge and database Docker networks, and an HTTPS reverse proxy. For AMD/Intel hardware transcoding, /dev/dri/renderD128 must exist on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Required HTTPS origin served by the reverse proxy, for example https://rivune.example.com. Non-loopback HTTP is rejected.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone name, for example Europe/Paris; controls profile access dates and daily hours.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname or IP on the database-only Docker network. The server certificate SAN must match this exact value (DNS name or IP address).

Config.Name: PostgreSQL port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL TCP port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL database
Config.Description: Existing PostgreSQL database name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL user
Config.Description: Dedicated non-superuser application role with membership in the non-login database owner role. Never configure the PostgreSQL bootstrap or restore login here.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Password supplied to Rivune through its environment. Required.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA certificate
Config.Description: Public CA certificate that signs the PostgreSQL server certificate. Mount only ca.crt here, never the CA private key.

Config.Name: Initial setup token
Config.Description: One-time value supplied through the environment to claim the server. Use a long random value.

Config.Name: Container user ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard non-root nobody user ID. Rivune assigns the transcode directory to this user before dropping privileges.

Config.Name: Container group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard users group ID.

Config.Name: Transcode directory
Config.Description: Temporary HLS and transcoding data. Prefer a cache-pool path; the container prepares its ownership automatically.

Config.Name: AMD/Intel render device
Config.Description: VAAPI or Intel Quick Sync render node. Remove this entry when no AMD/Intel GPU is available.

Config.Name: Hardware acceleration
Config.Description: Encoder selection: auto, software, vaapi, qsv, or nvenc.

Config.Name: Video device path
Config.Description: Container path to the VAAPI/Quick Sync render device.

Config.Name: Video device group ID
Config.Description: Numeric GID owning the render device on the Unraid host. Find it with: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128

Config.Name: Media temporary directory
Config.Description: Internal path corresponding to the Transcode directory mapping.

Config.Name: Maximum transcode storage (MB)
Config.Description: Global upper bound for temporary playback media, from 512 to 102400 MB.

Config.Name: Remux concurrency
Config.Description: Maximum concurrent FFmpeg media jobs, from 1 to 16.

Config.Name: Software transcode threads
Config.Description: CPU threads used by the libx264 software fallback, from 1 to 32.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL SSL mode
Config.Description: Required fail-closed TLS mode. Keep verify-full so the PostgreSQL certificate chain and host SAN are authenticated; do not use disable, allow, prefer, or require.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA path
Config.Description: Required container path matching the read-only PostgreSQL CA certificate mount.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxies
Config.Description: Proxy IP address or narrow CIDR network allowed to supply forwarding headers. Configure only the dedicated edge Docker network; never trust the database network, a LAN, or 0.0.0.0/0.

Config.Name: LAN artwork origins
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated exact HTTP(S) origins for trusted LAN artwork servers. Use only private IP literals with explicit ports; never enter hostnames, paths, queries, tokens, loopback, or link-local addresses.

Config.Name: Jellyfin initial default
Config.Description: Initial default for Rivune's limited Jellyfin-compatible API. After setup, use the administrator settings page to enable or disable it without recreating the container.

Config.Name: TMDB access token
Config.Description: Optional TMDB API read access token supplied through the environment.

Config.Name: Fanart.tv project API key
Config.Description: Optional Fanart.tv project key for high-resolution posters, backdrops, logos, and season artwork.

Config.Name: MDBList API key
Config.Description: Optional MDBList API key for collection list sources.

Config.Name: TVDB API key
Config.Description: Optional TVDB API key supplied through the environment.

Config.Name: TVDB subscriber PIN
Config.Description: Optional PIN used only with a TVDB user-supported API key. Leave empty for ordinary project keys.

Config.Name: Trakt client ID
Config.Description: Optional Trakt application client ID for collection sources and account tracking.

Config.Name: Trakt client secret
Config.Description: Trakt application client secret required with the client ID for account tracking.

Config.Name: Simkl client ID
Config.Description: Optional Simkl application client ID for account tracking.

Config.Name: Tracking encryption key
Config.Description: 64-character hexadecimal key encoding exactly 32 bytes, required when Trakt or Simkl account tracking is enabled. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Internal HTTP listener for the HTTPS reverse proxy. Do not publish this port on the Unraid host.
